health.detail: CDC says to consider hepatitis A vaccine for most travelers, and recommends it for higher-risk activities such as rural travel or eating street food. Hepatitis B vaccine is recommended for unvaccinated travelers younger than 60. CDC does not recommend yellow fever vaccine for this destination; the page lists the country's own entry rule separately. Tick-borne encephalitis vaccine is recommended for extensive tick exposure in endemic areas. Dogs infected with rabies are not commonly found in Sweden. Travel health notices on the page: Global Measles (Level 1, May 28, 2025). This is a short summary of CDC's traveler page, not medical advice; CDC advises seeing a doctor at least a month before the trip.
